labels.label: eligible

evidence.quote: Have disease that is metastatic at the time of screening
on at least 1 novel androgen receptor pathway inhibition (ARPI) but no more than 2 different ARPI
who have not received treatment with a poly (ADP-ribose) polymerase (PARP) inhibitor
Received cytotoxic chemotherapy for prostate cancer in any setting

labels.note: mCRPC after apalutamide, BRCA2 already treated with olaparib, chemo-naive, ECOG 0-1.

labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: Treatment with at least one, but no more than one, prior second-generation ARPi
Presence of liver metastasis
Fasting glucose <100 mg/dL and HbA1c < 5.7%

labels.note: Fits one prior ARPI, no liver mets, chemo-naive; strict fasting glucose/HbA1c limits are unknown.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Be diagnosed with Stage I-IV prostate cancer without metastases to bone
Be starting ADT or have received their first ADT treatment in the past 6 months

labels.note: Requires no bone metastases and starting ADT; patient has bone metastases.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Known history of immunodeficiency virus (HIV) or hepatitis B or hepatitis C infection
Documented castration resistant prostate cancer (mCRPC)

labels.note: History of hepatitis C is an exclusion.

labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: Participants must not have received any taxane regimens since becoming castration-resistant
Previous treatment with at least 1 novel androgen axis drug (NAAD)
Participants must have at least one PSMA-positive (prostate-specific membrane antigen) distant metastatic lesion

labels.note: Taxane-naive mCRPC fits Group B; PSMA PET positivity unknown.

labels.label: not_relevant

evidence.quote: Patients undergoing initial treatment consultation for clinically localized prostate cancer
Patients with locally advanced or metastatic prostate cancer

labels.note: Shared decision-making study for localized prostate cancer.

labels.label: eligible

evidence.quote: Have received ≤ 2 anti-androgen therapies in either the HSPC or CRPC setting
Prior treatment with any CAR-T cell therapy, approved or investigational T-cell engager therapy, and prior receipt of radioligand therapy

labels.note: Fits dose expansion: one ARPI, no taxane; no prior radioligand or T-cell engager.

labels.label: eligible

evidence.quote: Evidence of metastatic disease as confirmed by radiographic imaging
Prior therapy with an Androgen Receptor Pathway Inhibitors (ARPI).
ECOG PS of 0 or 1
Has active or uncontrolled HCV infection.

labels.note: Metastatic progressing CRPC after ARPI, ECOG 0-1, hepatitis C cured.

labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: Patients must have a positive PSMA PET/CT scan
Patients must have received at least one androgen receptor pathway inhibitor (ARPI)
Patients must not have previously received a taxane based chemotherapy regimen for mCRPC
Patients with a history of hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection must have been treated and cured

labels.note: Taxane-naive mCRPC after ARPI, cured HCV allowed; needs positive PSMA PET (unknown).

labels.label: possibly

evidence.quote: Participant has previously received a NHA (ie, abiraterone, enzalutamide, apalutamide, darolutamide) and a taxane
they must also have received a PARP-inhibitor or be intolerant of this therapy

labels.note: Requires prior taxane (patient chemo-naive) unless ineligible or refusing, at investigator discretion.

labels.label: excluded

evidence.quote: Prior treatments with an androgen receptor pathway inhibitor (ARPI) and taxane-based chemotherapy, and progressed on or after [177Lu]Lu-PSMA targeted therapy.

labels.note: Requires prior taxane and progression after Lu-PSMA; patient has had neither.

labels.label: eligible

evidence.quote: Had previously received one or two prior androgen receptor pathway inhibitor treatments
Must not have received systemic cytotoxic chemotherapy, including taxane-based chemotherapy, for mCRPC.
Must have an Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance score of 0 or 1.

labels.note: Progressing after one ARPI, no chemo for mCRPC, ECOG 0-1.

labels.label: eligible

evidence.quote: Progression (as defined below) after the receipt of at least one or more approved second-generation androgen-receptor-pathway inhibitors
Must have at least one measurable lesion per RECIST v1.1 at time of screening.
Participants with a history of hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection should have completed curative antiviral treatment
Known visceral metastases, except for lung metastases.

labels.note: Progressing mCRPC after ARPI, measurable enlarging node, cured HCV allowed, no visceral mets.

labels.label: eligible

evidence.quote: Prior disease progression on 1, and only 1, androgen receptor pathway inhibitor (ARPI)
Prior disease progression on or intolerance to abiraterone.
Prior treatment with any chemotherapy regimen in the mCRPC setting

labels.note: Progressed on exactly one ARPI (apalutamide), chemo-naive, no prior abiraterone.

labels.label: eligible

evidence.quote: Participant is required to have progressed on no more than one prior treatment with a second generation ARSI
Participant has received any prior chemotherapy
unless these therapies are not appropriate for the participant

labels.note: One prior ARSI, no chemo, BRCA2 already treated with PARP inhibitor.

labels.label: not_relevant

evidence.quote: prior diagnosis of prostate cancer (Grade Group >1)
metastatic prostate cancer
